about: The names a file is filed under, for the Materializer app (clients/os/src/apps/materializer/make.ts, filedName) and the engine (integrations/compose, filedFileName) to agree on. Each row is a name as typed, the kind of file (format, deployableKind, outputKind) and what the engine files it as; filed is empty where the engine refuses the name. os_copies_test.go computes every row through the engine's own parse and filing, and make.test.ts through filedName. Left out on purpose, because the two sides differ there by the platforms' own rules and not by drift: a name with U+0085 or U+FEFF at an edge (Go trims the first as a space and JavaScript the second), with U+0130 or U+212A in an extension (they case-fold differently), with a control character or over 150 characters (the app refuses those as they are typed). A name cut at 120 bytes inside a character is filed with the cut bytes as they are; the table shows them as one U+FFFD, which is what the app shows.
